sections.content: Spanish contrasts former and current professional situations by combining past tenses with the present. Expressions such as antes, durante varios años, actualmente and ahora establish the time frame.

items.spanish: Antes trabajaba en una empresa pequeña, pero actualmente trabajo por mi cuenta.
items.english: I used to work for a small company, but I currently work for myself.

items.spanish: Mi antiguo puesto tenía menos responsabilidades que el actual.
items.english: My former position had fewer responsibilities than my current one.

items.spanish: Durante varios años trabajé en ventas y después ascendí a un puesto de gestión.
items.english: For several years I worked in sales and then I was promoted to a management position.

items.spanish: Ahora tengo más experiencia y puedo asumir proyectos más complejos.
items.english: Now I have more experience and can take on more complex projects.

sections.content: Use the imperfecto for background situations and habitual states, the indefinido for completed professional events, and the present for the current situation.
